content.text: - GERD: d/c PPI, if need -> lowest dose that controls & maintains healing (escalate tx)
Objective reflux testing: ambulatory pH OR impedance monitoring
Tx:  1.  PPI BID                                    4.  PPI + Baclofen: limited evidence -Oral skeleton relaxant
PPI 4-8wks     -    H2RA if poor PPI response
*: bismuth quad ⍉option, refer-penicillin allergy test &/or desensitization
Prevent NSAID-PUD in pt using NSAIDs
-   Test/tx H.Pylori b4 chronic NSAID tx
High risk: COX-2 inhibitor (instead of NSAID) + PPI
Very high risk: avoid NSAID -> COX-2 inhibitors + PPI
Cont PPI for duration of NSAID use
*H2RA: protective if high dose -less effective than PPI even w high dose
↓ NSAID/stop       -    Test for H.pylori -> eradicate          -    PPI x8wks         -    Alt: vonoprazan, misoprostol
